provenance: Original fixture authored for this project, 2026-10-15. No external vendor or sample data.
independent_method: Hand-calculated Box-Cox power transformation contracts. For strictly positive y > 0: if lambda == 0: ln(y); else: (y^lambda - 1)/lambda. Verifies exact transformation for lambda in {2.0, 0.5, -1.0, 0.0}, maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) of optimal lambda via profile log-likelihood Brent minimization, null and user missing-code preservation, zero-variance rejection, non-positive value rejection (error.transform_domain), and invalid parameter handling.
